allow: PowerShell(function Get-Status\($url\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 240 -MaximumRedirection 0; return [int]$r.StatusCode } catch { if \($_.Exception.Response\) { return [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode } else { return "ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } } }; "/picks -> $\(Get-Status 'http://localhost:3001/picks'\)"; "/picks/wellness -> $\(Get-Status 'http://localhost:3001/picks/wellness'\)"; "/picks/wellness/foo -> $\(Get-Status 'http://localhost:3001/picks/wellness/foo'\)")
